## Privacy and German Legal Review

Apply [the privacy baseline](../security/DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY.md), especially PRIV-020. For each item below mark Applicable, Not applicable with reason, or Open with owner and resolution before affected launch. Include official legal/guidance sources and evidence requirements:
- Processing purposes, people, sources, data categories and minimum fields.
- Legal basis, necessity and mandatory/optional collection.
- Purpose-based permissions and record/field scopes.
- Notices and valid consent/withdrawal/objection where relevant.
- Category retention, holds, deletion and backup restoration.
- Rights requests, authoritative corrections and secure exports.
- Suppliers, factual controller/processor roles, AVV and transfers.
- TDDDG device access and UWG communications.
- Security, incidents and measurable verification.
- DPO/DPIA and sector-law applicability.

Do not copy private customer records or confidential operating evidence into this public repository. Link stable PRIV IDs; identify unresolved legal launch blockers separately from product proposals.
